about.text: Hi, I'm Guilherme Farias and I'm {yearsOld} years old. I completed the Pós Tech postgraduate program in Front-End Engineering at FIAP and earned a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from Faculdade Impacta. I'm passionate about technology and its potential for innovation, with more than six years of experience in web development.
about.text2: I'm currently studying Three.js and D3.js to bring smart dashboards and 3D elements to the web and improve the user experience.
about.text3: Beyond programming, I enjoy creating RPG adventures, illustrations, and CSS animations. I also like outdoor activities such as running, cycling, and skateboarding.
